qui-gon-jinn--influencing-chance.text:
Sentinel
When Played/On Attack: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may discard 1 of them. Put the rest back on top in any order.

rogue-one--at-any-cost.text: When a friendly unit is defeated: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put any number of them on the bottom of your deck and the rest on top in any order.
